Agriculture Course / Spiritual Foundations for the Renewal of Agriculture

Rudolf Steiner; additional editorial and retrospective contributors separately attributed · GA 327

Primary study text: Rudolf Steiner, Spiritual Foundations for the Renewal of Agriculture, GA 327, translated by Catherine E. Creeger and Malcolm Gardner, edited by Malcolm Gardner; Bio-Dynamic Farming and Gardening Association, 1993. Compared with George Adams’s 1958 classic translation, reissued by Rudolf Steiner Press in 2012. Review uses the supplied OCR Markdown companions; PDF images were unavailable.

Alcance do estudo: All 192 Creeger/Gardner and 178 Adams supplied Markdown capture blocks: eight lectures, four discussions, separate addresses/reports and available appendices/end matter.

Limites das evidências
  • Both supplied PDFs exceed the executor transfer limit of 32 MiB; no visual PDF page, drawing or plate verification was performed.
  • The Creeger/Gardner export ends during Literature Cited at capture192, displayed88%; bibliography is partial, and the remaining index and colour plates are absent.
  • Appendix A handwritten material has poor OCR; illegible details have not been reconstructed.
  • Some wording, numerical and botanical details disagree between the translations and remain unresolved.
  • Source study does not independently validate the proposed spiritual, agronomic or health mechanisms.
  • Full uploaded files remain private; public output contains original explanations, concise excerpts and authored notes.
